mapper.update: UPDATE user_coupon SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE status = 'UNUSED' AND expire_time IS NOT NULL AND expire_time < #{now}
mapper.select: SELECT uc.id, uc.coupon_id, c.coupon_name, c.plan_code, p.plan_name, c.duration_days, uc.user_id, u.username, u.display_name, uc.claim_no, uc.status, uc.receive_time, uc.use_time, uc.expire_time FROM user_coupon uc LEFT JOIN coupon c ON c.coupon_id = uc.coupon_id LEFT JOIN vip_plan p ON p.plan_code = c.plan_code LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = uc.user_id WHERE uc.coupon_id = #{couponId} ORDER BY uc.id DESC
